guides.text:
# Tong Heng International · 同興國際

Version 0.1 · Initial identity extracted from the existing company website.

## Company and positioning

澳門同興國際發展有限公司

Macau Tong Heng International Development Co., Ltd.

Companhia de Desenvolvimento Internacional Tong Heng (Macau), Limitada

以澳門為樞紐，連接中國產業能力與全球市場。

A Macau-based gateway connecting Chinese industrial capability with global markets.

The existing introduction describes AI services, Chinese companies’ overseas expansion, AIGC short-drama distribution, and investment and industrial consulting. Its stated markets include Portuguese-speaking countries and Southeast Asia. Describe the company as an advisor and execution partner; avoid implying licensed financial intermediary status. These are source descriptions, not independently verified corporate facts.

## Identity

Use the existing gateway-and-upward-arrow symbol in `assets/symbol.svg`. Preserve its proportions and colors. Give it at least one quarter of its width in clear space; use at 32 px or larger. These sizing rules are initial recommendations. Do not redraw, rotate, stretch or add effects. This is an extracted website symbol, pending confirmation as the official corporate logo.

Navy #0F1E38 anchors headers and dark backgrounds. Gold #C8A45C highlights actions and small graphic details. White #FFFFFF is the main page background; ink #1A2233 is body text; slate #5B6B85 is secondary text. Use gold as decoration or on navy, not small text on white. Consume `tokens.json` or `tokens.css` for exact values.

Use Traditional Chinese first, with English and Portuguese as needed. Preserve legal names exactly as supplied above, pending legal confirmation. Use Noto Sans TC with system fallbacks for body text; Cambria or Georgia can distinguish English display headlines. Font files are not bundled.

## Layout and voice

Use generous white space, a 1200 px content limit, a 24 px page gutter, and the spacing scale in tokens.json. Keep one main message per section. On small screens stack content in reading order. Use restrained borders and clear headings.

Write concrete, professional copy around capabilities, markets and execution. Prefer specific service descriptions over promises of returns or invented performance claims. Do not publish unsourced figures, client names, licenses or guarantees.

## Accessibility

Use navy text on gold buttons, ink on white for body copy, visible keyboard focus and descriptive link labels. Give standalone symbols a meaningful text alternative; hide decorative repetitions from assistive technology. Check contrast for every new color pairing.

## Applications

Proposals: navy cover, gold rule, Traditional Chinese company name and English secondary name. Websites: white content sections and navy gateway hero. Business stationery: company legal name, verified contact details, and the unmodified symbol. Contact details must come from confirmed business records.
